vulnerability.explanation: When an element reports n_numaux >= 1, the code unconditionally reads an aux entry at esl + isymesz without checking that at least one aux entry remains within bounds (neither against eslend nor the overall symbol table). If the last element claims an aux or the counts are malformed, this read goes past the allocated symbol array.
